altText: Describe the nature of God through His attributes.
detailedDescription: Classroom-friendly illustration using simple icons (love, patience, mercy, wisdom, light) to represent God's attributes, with learners discussing respectfully.

altText: Explain how humankind and the environment interrelate.
detailedDescription: Simple ecosystem scene showing people, plants, animals, water and air with arrows indicating interdependence (oxygen, food, shelter) in a Ghanaian setting.

altText: Explain the religious and moral lessons in preserving the environment.
detailedDescription: Learners doing tree planting and clean-up exercises, with stewardship and responsibility shown through simple symbols (checklist, recycling bin), non-graphic.

altText: Discuss the importance of prayer in our lives.
detailedDescription: Respectful, inclusive illustration of prayer as communication, gratitude and seeking guidance—shown through calm scenes (individual, family, community) without specific sacred texts.

altText: Gather and record data on religious festivals.
detailedDescription: Learners interviewing community members and writing notes, using simple charts to record festival names and activities, in a friendly community scene.

altText: Explain the need for celebrating various festivals.
detailedDescription: Festival scene emphasizing unity, sharing and community bonding (people greeting, sharing food, reconciliation handshake), respectful and inclusive.

altText: Discuss moral lessons from the festivals.
detailedDescription: Class discussion circle with icons for generosity, forgiveness, kindness, perseverance and gratitude; learners reflecting on moral lessons in daily life.

altText: Narrate the story of the latter lives of the leaders of the major religions.
detailedDescription: Symbolic timeline showing key later-life events using neutral icons (journey, teaching, gathering, meal, prayer, farewell) without graphic or sensitive depiction.

altText: Identify the moral lessons from the latter lives of the religious leaders.
detailedDescription: Learners writing virtues on the board (humility, forgiveness, obedience, perseverance, faithfulness) and role-playing good conduct in a classroom setting.

altText: Demonstrate ways they can commit themselves to the community.
detailedDescription: Community service collage: clean-up exercise, helping elderly, reporting problems to adults, protecting public property—positive and safe scenes.

altText: Explain the need to be committed members of the community.
detailedDescription: Illustration showing peace and progress from community commitment: clean surroundings, cooperative people, shared projects, harmony—no politics.

altText: Identify the role of children in promoting harmony with other family members.
detailedDescription: Family harmony scene: child helping with chores, respectful greetings, sharing, listening to elders; warm, non-argumentative tone.

altText: Explain the need for cordial relationships among family members.
detailedDescription: Peaceful family communication: talking calmly, apology, teamwork at home, shared meal—simple and classroom-appropriate.

altText: Identify attitudes and behaviours of a responsible family member.
detailedDescription: Responsible behaviour collage: punctuality, helping younger ones, respecting elders, taking initiative, participating in family activities; friendly home scene.
